ranked.headline: Pretrained protein encoders are being adapted to design, fitness, and co-folding tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple pretrained protein language models and co-folding with structural restraints and equivariant geometry.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware ML and dynamics workflows prioritize drug and target candidates
ranked.summary: Recent work couples dynamics, fine-tuning and open datasets with prediction, and one preprint reports benchmark leakage inflating reported performance.

ranked.headline: Shared representations linking histology, transcriptomics, and genetic alterations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple omics, histology, and genetic data via alignment, optimal transport, and graph learning for prediction and translation.

ranked.headline: Empirical Bayes imputation and denoising of multimodal pooled perturbation readouts
ranked.summary: Optical pooled screens and Perturb-seq now yield joint RNA, protein, and chromatin readouts that require shared denoising and imputation models.

ranked.headline: Long-read workflows couple sample prep, assembly, and profiling for genome recovery
ranked.summary: Recent preprints on nanopore and CycloneSEQ platforms tie wet-lab prep, assembly, and profiling choices to recovery of complete genomes and communities.

ranked.headline: Sequence-to-function models predict expression, splicing, and regulatory variant effects
ranked.summary: Held-out testing and external validation are shifting sequence models toward generalization and reliability rather than in-sample accuracy alone.

ranked.headline: Reliability estimates and proteome-wide scores refine variant functional interpretation
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale variant predictors now sit alongside per-variant reliability estimates, shifting prioritization from rank order toward confidence.

ranked.headline: Interpretable deep learning predicts peptide toxicity, ADMET, drug synergy, and pKa
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair interpretable architectures with endpoint-specific outputs across toxicity, ADMET, synergy, and protonation tasks.

ranked.headline: Metabolic inference addresses model uncertainty, pool variability and enzyme constraints
ranked.summary: Recent work moves metabolic inference beyond single models and datasets, with new flux, kinetic and community formulations appearing in May 2026.

ranked.headline: Unpaired single-cell and spatial data integrated via shared latent representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair scRNA-seq with spatial, multi-omic, and perturbation data using interpretable deep learning and optimal-transport pipelines.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome references improve complex diploid genome analysis
ranked.summary: Near-T2T diploid assembly, a 20-haplotype Japanese pangenome, and personalized cancer references now resolve complex genomic regions that conventional…

ranked.headline: Computational methods tackle bias, normalisation and batch effects in epigenomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication introduce new software for Hi-C, CUT&RUN, methylation arrays and multi-omics analysis.

ranked.headline: Foundation models extract gene regulation and microbial traits from raw sequence
ranked.summary: Protein and DNA language models are being benchmarked and repurposed for promoters, homolog retrieval, and microbiome-linked phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Phylogenomic tools infer proteome alignments, translation tables and viral taxonomy
ranked.summary: Reference-free alignment, classifier-based tree interpretation and genetic code prediction are now packaged as usable software.

ranked.headline: Interactive software environments are making omics analyses inspectable and curatable
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications package omics inference into runnable visual environments with interactive browsing and curation.

ranked.headline: Quasi-steady-state reduction misplaces transition timing near tipping points
ranked.summary: Widely used timescale reductions can misplace transitions, and new neural and large-scale simulation approaches revisit how model structure is set.

ranked.headline: Performance-focused tools for phylogenetics, read mapping, and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published format paper package performance-critical data handling as reusable libraries and binary formats.

ranked.headline: Conserved transcriptomic clocks and newborn-cell dynamics track mammalian aging
ranked.summary: Cross-mammal transcriptomic clocks, tissue-resolved newborn-cell maps, and non-invasive aging clocks now quantify biological age from distinct readouts.

ranked.headline: Contiguous eukaryotic genome assemblies enable association analysis in polyploid crops
ranked.summary: Long-read and proximity-ligation data now yield chromosome-scale polyploid assemblies, paired with trait genetics in sugarcane.

ranked.headline: Sequence-derived variables predict SARS-CoV-2 antibody, T cell, and vaccine outcomes
ranked.summary: Prolonged infections, emerging variants, and flavivirus envelope mutations make sequence-to-phenotype inference increasingly pressing for risk prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence and structure models predict protein interactions and phase separation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend learned graph and multimodal embeddings to protein-protein interaction and structure classification tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks determining what single-cell and spatial experiments can resolve
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and frameworks quantify how multi-omic, lineage-tracing, and spatial design choices constrain single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Structured models move GWAS inference from loci to context-indexed genetic networks
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published framework now apply graph, tensor, and causal-network structure to GWAS summary statistics beyond single loci.

ranked.headline: Explicitly specified knowledge graphs for biomedical evidence and admissible inference
ranked.summary: Three preprints pair literature-derived graph construction with ontology alignment and admissibility rules that govern how traversal may proceed.

ranked.headline: Reference and pipeline choices shape variant and fusion detection accuracy in sequencing
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies how reference structure and sequence representation change variant and fusion calls against defined truth sets.

ranked.headline: Normative models of sensory computation tested against neural and behavioral data
ranked.summary: Predictive, relay, and random-network frameworks are now being checked against visual, multisensory, and population recording data.

ranked.headline: Known-truth benchmarks validate proteomics quantification and cytometry grouping
ranked.summary: Known-by-construction benchmarks now test both quantification and grouping steps that set differential and population-level conclusions.

ranked.headline: Extracting thermodynamic and electrostatic quantities from simulated and measured data
ranked.summary: Recent work converts MD, synaptic-cleft simulations, and patch-clamp recordings into thermodynamic and electrostatic values with explicit corrections.

ranked.headline: Inferring directionality and temporal order from static transcriptomic snapshots
ranked.summary: Spatial causal inference and time-structured embedding now extract directionality from single-timepoint transcriptomic measurements.

ranked.headline: Large cohorts attribute human variation to transmission route, tissue, and allele origin
ranked.summary: Fine-grained allele-level and cohort-scale analyses now separate variation by X-chromosome origin, mtDNA regulation, polygenic architecture, and rare-variant…

ranked.headline: Network topology and behavioral heterogeneity shape evolutionary and epidemic outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and an agent-based host-plasmid study show structure-dependent outcomes in fixation, cooperation, and epidemic spread across network models.

ranked.headline: MD and QM/MM simulations resolve covalent binding and inhibitor selectivity pathways
ranked.summary: Atomistic simulations now resolve binding pathways and contact networks that set inhibitor selectivity and photoinduced DNA binding.

ranked.headline: Anatomy-aware deep learning for interpretable prediction across retinal, CT, MRI imaging
ranked.summary: Explicit anatomical structure in deep models is being tested as a route to interpretable, data-efficient clinical prediction from routine imaging.

ranked.headline: Chemical fingerprints extend MHC II binding prediction to citrullinated peptides
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply sequence and chemical-feature learning to peptide drugs, pathogen vaccines, and antiviral activity prediction.

ranked.headline: Cryo-EM and cryo-ET methods resolve flexible protein conformational landscapes
ranked.summary: Deep learning and focused refinement now reconstruct flexible protein states directly from cryo-EM and cryo-ET particle and tomogram data.

ranked.headline: Multi-predictor consensus sharpens split-ORF and polyA isoform annotation
ranked.summary: Updated Split-ORF and metaAPA tools extend consensus prioritization across multiple predictors for transcript isoform calls.

ranked.headline: Ensemble dynamics explain gain- and loss-of-function receptor disease mutations
ranked.summary: Ensemble-level MD, Markov state models and coupling analyses now resolve how mutations and membranes reshape receptor conformational landscapes.

ranked.headline: Molecular states inferred from routine profiling checked against independent references
ranked.summary: Routine profiling data are being mined for genomic and molecular states, with validation against reference or independent measurements in these preprints.

ranked.headline: Learned and benchmarked computational tools for MS metabolomics feature processing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints propose new alignment, peptide prioritization, and TIMS benchmarking approaches, pressing for shared evaluation standards.

ranked.headline: Open computational tools extract quantitative measures from 3D microscopy and CT imaging
ranked.summary: Recent preprints release software for sample tilt quality control, cell mechanics inference, and spider visual field reconstruction from imaging data.
